description.value: Okanagan Select is the retail arm of the Okanagan Nation Alliance, selling sustainably harvested wild Sockeye salmon — one of only two remaining Sockeye populations in the Columbia River system. Products include canned, smoked, and pouched salmon produced through traditional selective fishing practices and certified Ocean Wise. The outlet is located in a commercial strip in Westbank, offering cyclists a unique opportunity to purchase locally harvested Indigenous wild salmon to take home.

address.value: 105-3535 Old Okanagan Highway, Westbank, BC V4T 3L7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Okanagan Select is an active First Nations-operated wild salmon retail outlet in Westbank, BC, run by the Okanagan Nation Alliance. enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active retail outlet operated by the Okanagan Nation Alliance with a physical walk-in location; a cyclist could purchase wild salmon products here. always_include flag also set.
enrichment_extras.notes: Walk-in sales are also available at the Okanagan Nation Alliance Reception at 101-3535 Old Okanagan Highway when the Westbank Hub is closed. Mailing address differs from outlet address (101 vs 105).
